summary: This note is a Wikipedia-derived infobox and chronology for the 1992 single "Baby Got Back" by Sir Mix-a-Lot, taken from the album Mack Daddy. It lists the release date, format, recording year, genre, length, label, songwriter and producers. It also places the single in Sir Mix-a-Lot's singles sequence alongside "One Time's Got No Case" and "Swap Meet Louie". The body text of the article is not included.
one_line: Sir Mix-a-Lot's 1992 hip hop single "Baby Got Back" from the album Mack Daddy, released on Def American.
key_facts: "Baby Got Back" is a single by Sir Mix-a-Lot from the album Mack Daddy.
The single's B-side is "Cake Boy" and it was released with "You Can't Slip" as a B-side listing.
"Baby Got Back" was released on May 7, 1992.
The single was issued in 7-inch vinyl, 12-inch vinyl, cassette and CD formats.
The song's genres are listed as hip hop, dirty rap and bounce.
The song's length is listed as 4:22.
The single was released on the Def American label.
The songwriter credited is Anthony Ray.
The producers credited are Rick Rubin and Sir Mix-a-Lot.
The preceding single in the chronology is "One Time's Got No Case" (1991).
The following single in the chronology is "Swap Meet Louie" (1992).
